create_program_database: create a ProgramDatabase instance with a DatabaseConfig to store and evolve programs using MAP-Elites and island-based population model
add_program_to_database: add a Program to the database with optional target island assignment and automatic novelty checking via embedding similarity
sample_programs_for_evolution: sample a parent program and inspiration programs from the database using exploration, exploitation, or weighted strategies
get_best_program: get the best program from the database ranked by fitness score or a specific metric
migrate_programs_between_islands: migrate top programs between islands using ring topology to share good solutions and maintain diversity
